label.indications_and_usage: 1 INDICATIONS AND USAGE REDEMPLO is indicated as an adjunct to diet to reduce triglycerides in adults with familial chylomicronemia syndrome (FCS). REDEMPLO is an apolipoprotein C-III ( apoC-III )-directed small interfering ribonucleic acid (siRNA) indicated as an adjunct to diet to reduce triglycerides in adults with familial chylomicronemia syndrome (FCS).
